landing.tagline: Live football you can follow by ear.
landing.fiction: A made-up match between made-up clubs.
landing.screenReader: Earshot speaks in its own voice. Using a screen reader? Switch to text after you start.
landing.headphones: Best with headphones. You'll hear left, then right.

listen.transcriptEmpty: Lines appear here as they're spoken.
listen.recapsEmpty: The half-time and full-time recaps appear here.
listen.soundBlocked: Sound is blocked. Tap to restore sound.
listen.giveUp: Couldn't reach the match. Try again.
listen.outputAppHint: Earshot speaks every line, with the ball placed in sound.
listen.outputReaderHint: Lines go to your screen reader at your own speed. The ball sound keeps playing.
listen.busy: Earshot is busy. Try again in a few minutes, or play the recorded clip.
listen.pitch: Pitch map: {{home}} attack left to right, {{away}} right to left. The ball is the dot.

output.title: How should Earshot talk to you?
output.appHint: Earshot speaks every line, with the ball placed in sound. Best with headphones.
output.readerHint: Lines go to your screen reader at your own speed. The ball sound keeps playing.
output.oneEarHint: Everything centred, for one earbud or one good ear.

mode.title: How much detail?
mode.casualHint: What happened and who did it. Numbers only for the score, the minute and the hardest shots.
mode.analystHint: The same, plus the numbers: pass lengths, shot speeds and how each team's tactics are changing.

stat.title: Follow one stat?
stat.noneHint: Every Analyst line, with no stat singled out.
stat.press_heightHint: Told when a team presses 5 metres higher or lower than before.
stat.dangerHint: Told when a team has one of its most threatening spells.
stat.pass_difficultyHint: Every very hard pass, and whether it came off.
stat.possessionHint: Told when a team's share of the ball jumps by 10 points.

agents.title: Behind the voice
agents.lede: These agents share one audio channel; a separate auditor re-checks every line. This is what each one last decided.
agents.airtime: On air {{seconds}} s of the last minute.
